name: Dynamic Sports / Action
visual_style: High-quality live-action sports cinematography showing athletic effort, natural sweat and energetic compositions.
camera: Dynamic lateral tracking and purposeful high-frame-rate slow motion where appropriate.
lighting: Contrasty yet plausible sports or outdoor lighting.
motion: Biomechanically accurate athletic action, clear momentum, real weight transfer and impacts.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
